title: Two Sum
subtitle: LeetCode #1 • Hash Map & Complement Intuition
voiceoverText: In Two Sum, we are given an array of numbers and a target value of 9. The requirement is to return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target, not the values. Instead of checking every pair in O(N squared), we use a Hash Map. Complement equals Target minus Current. At index 0, we have 2, and need 7. It's not in memory, so we store 2 at index 0. At index 1, we have 7, and need 2. We check our map, and 2 is already stored at index 0! That gives us our match: indices 0 and 1, in linear O(N) time.
